learning.learning_goal: Connect number names, numerals, and groups from 18 through 20.
learning.big_idea: A number tells how many dots there are.
novice_success_criteria: Recognize a number name and count a new arrangement.

screens.title: Meet 18–20.
screens.audio: Listen to the numbers. Count the dots. Then try it yourself.

screens.label: Number 18
screens.title: 18 — eighteen
screens.audio: This is eighteen. Tap the dots to hear them in order.

visual.ariaLabel: 18 blue dots. First ten, then 8 more.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Count every dot once. Choose the number.

visual.ariaLabel: 18 blue dots. First ten, then 8 more.

choices.feedback: Count the first ten. Then count the dots below.
Count the first ten. Then count the dots below.

hints: Count the first ten. Then count the dots below.
Count on from ten to eighteen.

screens.label: Make a group
screens.title: Make 18 dots.
screens.audio: Tap Add a dot until you have eighteen dots. Check your dots.
screens.wrongFeedback: Count again. Add or remove a dot.
screens.tooFewFeedback: You need 18 dots. Add a dot, then count again.
screens.tooManyFeedback: You need 18 dots. Remove a dot, then count again.
